figures.finding: Mauritania taxes employment income progressively: 15% on taxable remuneration from MRU 6,000 to 9,000, 25% from 9,000 to 21,000, and 40% above 21,000.
figures.applies: PwC does not state whether the bands are monthly or annual; the band below MRU 6,000 is read as untaxed because the scale starts there.

sources.said: Non-residents are only taxed on their Mauritanian-source income.

figures.finding: Social security is withheld monthly on gross salary up to MRU 15,000: 1% from the employee and 15% from the employer.

sources.said: Social security contributions are withheld monthly by employers and are computed on the basis of gross salary paid up to MRU 15,000. Rates of social security contributions are 1% for employees and 15% for employers.

figures.finding: Employers withhold tax and pay it by the 15th of the following month; a payer withholds 2.5% from a resident individual's service fee where the provider is under the personal business income tax.

sources.said: WHTs are due by the 15th day of the month following the withholding month.
Mauritanian services debtors must withhold 2.5% on remuneration paid to individuals who are resident.

figures.finding: Sums paid to non-residents for services provided or used in Mauritania (for up to six months, or twelve for subcontractors and oil operators) bear 15% withholding.
figures.applies: Royalties to non-resident companies also bear 15%.

sources.said: 15% WHT on sums paid to non-residents for services they provide or use in Mauritania for a period not exceeding 12 months for subcontractors and oil operators and six months in other cases

figures.finding: VAT is 16% on most commercial operations.

sources.said: Subject to certain exclusions, most commercial operations are subject to a 16% VAT.

figures.finding: The fiscal year is the calendar year; a self-employed person taxed on actual revenues files by 31 March of the next year and pays 40% by 31 March, 30% by 30 June and the balance by 30 September.

sources.said: The fiscal year is the calendar year.
Individuals subject to personal business income tax based on actual revenues should file the tax form by 31 March of the year following the end of the fiscal year.

figures.finding: The tax on wages and salaries (ITS) is computed monthly: the first MRU 6,000 a month of remuneration is exempt (and up to MRU 1,000 a month of allowances other than housing, transport, responsibility and function), and monthly taxable remuneration bears 15% up to MRU 9,000, 25% up to 21,000 and 40% above, withheld by the payer at each payment.
figures.applies: Employees (CGI arts. 110, 113, 114, 115, official edition updated to the 2020 finance law; PwC's 2026 summary gives the same bands).

figures.finding: A taxpayer charges VAT only once annual turnover before tax exceeds MRU 3,000,000, whatever the activity; tax is due from the day the threshold is passed.
figures.applies: CGI art. 211 as in the official edition updated to the 2020 finance law; changes by the 2021 to 2026 finance laws were not read.
